name: clinicaltrials-scraper
title: ClinicalTrials.gov Scraper – Condition, Phase & Site Mode
description: Scrape ClinicalTrials.gov's official NIH API: condition, intervention, sponsor, location, facility and lead-sponsor filters, plus six date windows (start, completion, first-posted, results). Optional one-row-per-site mode. No contact PII shipped, ever. $0.0015/result, no start fee.
